recovery: Reconstructed from the retained task conversation on 2026-10-18 after the cloud worktree reset. The failed prior upload is not a remote checkpoint; no original-byte or old-QA claim is made.
scope: Static stylized-inspired environment props for an imaginative world aimed at young children, not strict scientific reconstruction.

quality_tiers.environment-prop: Recognizable basic structure and appealing original surfaces at approximately 80–240 projected pixels, closest supported inspection around 360 pixels. Artistic color, texture, pose, proportion and harmless fine details are welcome.
quality_tiers.hero: A separately requested close-inspection role with its own stronger brief; do not apply hero standards to every supporting prop.

minimum_reference_policy: One or a few best available representative references are enough to start. Record creative choices and access limitations. Uncertain fine fossil reconstruction is advisory unless core identity is unclear. Use a descriptive inspired-by name for a loose design.
hard_blockers: Corrupt/unloadable export, missing dependencies, non-finite geometry, wrong units/origin or clearly broken materials.
Unreadable core identity, obvious accidental extra/missing major appendages, impossible major attachment or conspicuous unintended penetration at the supported viewing scale.
Unlicensed incorporated content, stale artifact evidence, misleading scientific certainty or exceeded frozen hard budgets.
advisories: Small hue/roughness differences, minor facet/seam variation and fine details outside the supported view envelope.
Labeled artistic colors, textures, pose/proportions, simplified or conservatively restored fine fossil details.
Deliberate invisible component overlap with a recorded implementation rationale.

review_policy.views: Six meaningful images: hero/front/right/rear/top/clay. Add one or two targeted views only for a real concern. Zero default orbit frames; the hero also serves as the one poster.
review_policy.reviewer: One fresh independent agent per candidate can cover visual, basic-reference and specification review together; no per-stage committee or self-review.
review_policy.revision_bound: One consolidated initial review and at most one planned cosmetic repair pass, then accept with advisories if no blocker remains. A genuine hard defect gets a targeted repair/retest; unresolved blockers are parked while other assets progress.
review_policy.escalation: No per-model user review. Ask only for a material scope/style/cost decision, conflicting constraints or missing authority.
review_policy.integrity: Keep automated export checks, exact hashes and honest parse/graphics/scene evidence. Unknown required runtime evidence is not a pass.

boundaries: No rig or animation-ready claim without a separate narrow animation profile and tests.
Cross-period curation is allowed in the labeled imaginative world, without claiming a scientific coexisting ecosystem.
Do not replace the existing ten release assets, accepted hashes/reviews, site allowlist or museum code as a side effect.
